provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Pandemic Legacy: Season 2 rulebook (Z-Man Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Supply cubes into the stockpile as the supply track shows for the month; extras to the reserve
Objectives and turning points from earlier games onto the board
Plague cubes on their spot; Incident marker on 0; Infection Rate marker on the leftmost 2
Read the Legacy deck one card at a time until a PAUSE or STOP card
Place all stockpile Supply cubes on grid locations, any number per location
Shuffle the Infection cards and flip 9: move 1 Supply cube from each city to the stockpile, or add a Plague cube and advance the Incident marker if it has none
steps.note: Rule stickers change this step later in the campaign

steps.text: Choose Rationed Event cards up to your rationing level (4 at the start); shuffle with the Produce Supplies and City cards
Split the rest into 5 piles with 1 Epidemic shuffled into each; stack them, smaller piles at the bottom
Each player picks a character: pawn and Reference cards; pawn at their home
Pick a pawn at random: that player goes first, then clockwise
